description.value: Chatime is a global bubble tea franchise with over 1,300 outlets worldwide, specialising in milk teas, fruit teas, boba smoothies, and cold-brew beverages. This location sits on the second floor of a building along Lougheed Highway, offering indoor seating and takeout for riders looking for a cold or warm drink. The brand's extensive menu includes both dairy and dairy-free drink options.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 98m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes and indoor_seating=yes, providing evidence for takeout and seating. The website (chatime.com) is the US-market Chatime corporate site; its store locator lists only US locations and does not include 4567 Lougheed Highway or any Canadian location, so address and amenity details specific to this location cannot be confirmed from website content. The website does show a 'Dairy free' filter on the drinks menu, supporting some vegan/dairy-free options as a brand-level standard.
concerns: The linked website (chatime.com) is the US-market Chatime corporate site. Its store locator lists only US locations; the 4567 Lougheed Highway, BC location does not appear, so address, hours, and amenities cannot be confirmed via website content. The Canadian franchise may operate under a separate domain (e.g. chatime.ca).
OSM community field is 'North Vancouver', but coordinates (49.2678°N, 123.0008°W) and the Lougheed Highway address correspond to Burnaby, BC, not the City or District of North Vancouver.
OSM tag level=2 indicates this is a second-floor unit, which may affect bike parking visibility from the street and accessibility with loaded touring bikes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational global franchise with a confirmed OSM record and looks_closed=false; a useful refreshment stop for touring cyclists regardless of limited confirmed amenity details.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website drinks menu includes a 'Dairy free' filter, confirming dairy-free drink options are available as a brand standard; most tea-based beverages are vegetarian by default
